glosses: Free from blame, not open to reproach or criticism; blameless.

examples.text: a gentleman of unimpeachable integrity

On the previous day, the prisoner had purchased strychnine at the village chemist’s shop, wearing a disguise by means of which he hoped to throw the onus of the crime upon another man—to wit, Mrs. Inglethorp’s husband, of whom he had been bitterly jealous. examples.text: He grew up in Norway, but he writes impeccable English.

glosses: Incapable of wrongdoing or sin; immaculate

examples.text: It was easy for James V to imprison Lady Glamis, but actually convicting her was far more difficult; her character was impeccable and she was highly respected by all who knew her.

glosses: Qui est absolument régulier ou correct.
